name: panel
title: Panel
description: The manga page model. Page is a book page in a fixed format (pocket, magazine, square, or a free-height strip; spread for a double page) that keeps its proportions and scales as one block: lines, gutters, bubbles and sound effects are sized in container units of the page. A page is made of Tier (bands, height share, slant of the cut below) holding Panel (width share, slant of the cut after it) or Column (tiers inside a cell); the code order is the reading order, and reading="rtl" lays panels out right to left. Gutters between tiers are wider than between panels. Panel options: bleed, frameless, overflow, ink, inset (laid over the previous panel), shape straight | tilted | jagged | cloud | memory. Twelve templates (template prop): three-tiers, big-plus-two, l-shape, diagonal, four-koma, spread, grid-six, splash, inset, columns, shock, flashback; Panel children fill a template in order. Place puts any element in a panel in percent from an anchor (x="72%" y="12%" anchor="top-right") and keeps it inside the panel; SpeechBubble pointAt aims its tail. PanelArt shows a picture framed by a focal point and zoom, toned with TonedImage. The same page can be given as data (page prop, PageData JSON, same structure as the JSX; see page-geometry.ts). Under 480px the page folds into a vertical strip. pageGeometry(data) and onGeometry give each panel's box in reading order (percent of the page) for panel-by-panel readers. PanelGrid, the first CSS-grid layout (cols, rows, colSpan, rowSpan, cut, padding), stays for existing code and becomes Page when given a page, template, format or Tier children. PanelCaption is the narration box (corner or free).
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/panel". Tier, Panel and Column must be direct children of Page or Tier (not wrapped in your own components): the page reads them to lay out the page.

meta.tagline: A manga page: tiers, slanted cuts, templates, bubbles that aim.
meta.usage:
import { Page, Panel, PanelArt, Place, Tier } from "@/components/manga/panel"
import { SpeechBubble } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"

<Page format="pocket">
  <Tier height={2} slant={6}>
    <Panel bleed>
      <PanelArt src="/street.jpg" alt="A street at night" toned />
      <Place x="72%" y="12%" anchor="top-right">
        <SpeechBubble pointAt={{ x: "30%", y: "80%" }}>Over here!</SpeechBubble>
      </Place>
    </Panel>
  </Tier>
  <Tier>
    <Panel width={2} slant={-4} />
    <Panel shape="jagged" />
  </Tier>
</Page>

// or a template, or data
<Page template="big-plus-two"><Panel>…</Panel><Panel>…</Panel><Panel>…</Panel></Page>
<Page page={pageData} />

props.name: format
props.description: On Page: fixed proportions (strip: free height).

props.name: template
props.description: On Page: a ready layout; Panel children fill it in order.

props.name: page
props.description: On Page: the page as data (same structure as the JSX).

props.name: reading
props.description: On Page: panel order; defaults to the data, then to data-reading on an ancestor.

props.name: spread / gutter / margin / line / lettering
props.type: boolean / { x, y } / number / number / number
props.description: On Page: double page, gutters, margin and line width in page units (a page is 100 wide), lettering scale.

props.name: onGeometry
props.description: On Page: every panel's box in reading order (page units and percent).

props.name: height / slant
props.description: On Tier: share of the page height; slant of the cut below, in page units.

props.name: width / slant
props.description: On Panel and Column: share of the tier width; slant of the cut after it.

props.name: shape
props.description: On Panel: outline (tilted: tilt in degrees).

props.name: bleed / frameless / overflow / ink
props.description: On Panel: runs off the page, no outline, content may leave the frame, ink background.

props.name: inset
props.description: On Panel: laid over the previous panel, box in percent of it.

props.name: art / items
props.description: On Panel: picture and bubbles as data (or children).

props.name: x / y / anchor
props.description: On Place: position in percent of the panel, and the anchor point.

props.name: maxWidth / clip / contain / rotate
props.description: On Place: maximum width (default the child's maxWidth, then 60%), stay inside the frame, nudge back inside the panel (default true), tilt.

props.name: src / alt / x / y / zoom / toned
props.type: string / string / number / number / number / boolean | options
props.description: On PanelArt: the picture, its focal point in percent, zoom, screentone.

props.name: cols / rows / colSpan / rowSpan / cut / padding
props.type: number / number / number / number / { side, size } / string
props.description: PanelGrid (first layout, kept for existing code).

props.name: position
props.description: On PanelCaption: corner, or free (in a Place).
